candidates.title: BANK SHOT
candidates.description: Drag back from a fixed launcher and release to fire a ball whose entire bounce path off the walls is committed at release, with no control afterward; chaining hits on one flight raises the payout.

candidates.title: RELAY GRID
candidates.description: Drag to wire the core to multiple docks; wiring persists and routes recurring pulses automatically, so the player must keep rerouting connections as overload risk shifts between docks.

candidates.title: QUEUE SHUFFLE
candidates.description: Drag to reorder waiting tiles in a line before a gate opens; the order in place at that moment decides which tiles get served and which get a multiplier.

candidates.title: SIGNAL WEAVE
candidates.description: Drag a single continuous stroke through moving nodes, keeping it only on same-colored nodes; the stroke commits on release and chain length sets the score.

candidates.title: TRACK DRAWER
candidates.description: Drag to draw a short track segment; once released, a ball rolls along the drawn slope under gravity toward scoring gates, so the drawn shape decides speed and direction.

candidates.title: VALVE SPLIT
candidates.description: Hold one of several valves to direct flow into its tank while the others keep filling untouched; the player must keep switching holds to stop any tank from overflowing.

candidates.title: LEDGE STACKER
candidates.description: Tap to drop a platform tile that must land aligned with the edge of the previous tile to keep the tower's footprint wide; misalignment narrows the landing zone for the next drop.

candidates.title: ORBIT TETHER
candidates.description: Drag to set launch angle and power for a tethered satellite around a planet, releasing commits it to a gravity-curved path the player must have aimed to land inside a capture ring.

candidates.title: ECHO CIRCUIT
candidates.description: Tap glowing nodes in the order they just pulsed, with the required sequence growing by one node after each successful repeat.

candidates.title: FLOW GATE
candidates.description: Tap to flip a bridge segment up or down so a falling colored item passes only through the matching gate state; the flip must be committed before the item arrives.

candidates.title: TENSION LATCH
candidates.description: Hold to wind a spring latch and release inside the correct tension window to launch a hook that grabs a passing crate; overwinding wastes the shot.

reason: BANK SHOT scores highest on C1/C3/C7 by introducing a mechanic none of the 22 existing works use — a fully pre-committed, no-control bounce trajectory — while also scoring the strongest C4 of the three finalists (simple wall-reflection physics vs. TRACK DRAWER's harder freeform-track collision), giving the best combination of novelty and stable implementability.
